conjectures.statement: Stronger sufficient sibling conjecture, not the canonical statement: let E_pi(n,N) be the sum of squared multiplicities of length-n factors among the first N fractional-digit starting positions of pi. For every real C > 0, eventually for every n there exists N >= 1 such that, after coercion to the reals, N^2 > C*n*E_pi(n,N).

Stronger sufficient sibling conjecture, not C1 or the canonical statement: let Q_pi(n,N) count ordered pairs 0 <= i,j < N for which the circle distance of (10^j-10^i)*pi to an integer is less than 10^(-n). For every real C > 0, eventually for every n there exists N >= 1 such that, after coercion to the reals, Q_pi(n,N) < N^2/(C*n).
